So, your future was shit with twin Androids killing everyone and even Gohan the last real fighter left. So you time travel back in time using Bulma's time machine to hopefully fix your world, she also gave you Goku grape favor heart medicine because he died before he could fight the droids.

So, you went around the time that Frieza and his father, King Cold, went to Earth, and you killed them. You knew the Z-Fighters were around, and Bulma too. You told them you knew when Goku would be back and gave them some food and beer to kill time.

What you didn't expect was Bulma flirting with you, and it was kind of hot and weird since she was your mother from the past. Luckily Goku just got back, you told him everything he needed to know and also gave him his heart meds from the future from Doctor Brief orders.

You went back to your time machine and... uh oh... Something was wrong! It didn't work for some reason! Luckily Bulma offered to fix it and also giving you a place to stay for the meantime. You just hope that she doesn't try to shoot her shot at you again since you considered her your mother
